parameters.command:
=tmux has-session -t n8n-{{ $json.session_id }} 2>/dev/null || tmux new-session -d -s n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}

# 2. Create marker file with timestamp
MARKER_FILE="/tmp/n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}-$(date +%s).done"
OUTPUT_FILE="/tmp/n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}-$(date +%s).out"
rm -f "$MARKER_FILE" "$OUTPUT_FILE"

# 3. Send command with tee (runs once, output goes to both tmux AND file)
tmux send-keys -t n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}:0 "python {{ $json.file_path }} 2>&1 | tee $OUTPUT_FILE; touch $MARKER_FILE" C-m

# 4. Wait for marker file
while [ ! -f "$MARKER_FILE" ]; do
    sleep 0.5
done

# 5. Output cleaned version (strip ANSI codes and progress bars)
sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$OUTPUT_FILE" | sed 's/\r/\n/g' | grep -v '━' | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | uniq

# 6. Clean up
rm -f "$MARKER_FILE" "$OUTPUT_FILE"
